name: bramble-release-tooling
description: Root package that pins the semantic-release toolchain the release pipeline runs. Not an application: the webapp keeps its own package.json under webapp/, and nothing in this file is published to a registry. It exists so .github/workflows/release-components.yml and the Release config job in .github/workflows/quality.yml install identical, lockfile-resolved versions instead of re-resolving every transitive dependency on each push to main.
